newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Acesita still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Acesita still a hold.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it has maintained its hold recommendation on Brazilian steelmaker Acesita after the release of second-quarter results.

-- ING analyst Mirela Rappaport said in a report Acesita posted an 11.0 million reais in the second quarter, up from two million reais in the first three-month period, enhanced by higher demand for stainless steel and nickel.
-- "Despite improvements at the operating level, interest expenses continued to grow," she wrote.
-- An expected rebound in nickel prices in 1998 and 1999 will lead to a recovery in international stainless steel prices, she said.
-- "Acesita will continue its efforts to gain market share both domestically and in the Mercosul countries, rather than practice aggressive price increases," she said.
-- In 1999, Acesita's debentures come due and this will lead to a substantial increase in interest expenses, she added.
-- She said the hold recommendation was based on expected improvements at the operating level.
-- Acesita preferred ended off 3.70 percent at 2.34 reais while its common closed down 3.3.72 percent at 2.07 reais in Sao Paulo.
